description_ru: Верхнечетвертичные отложения. Субаэральные покровные отложения. Суглинки
note: GGK-200 N-44-V (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR, 1st edition series of N-44-IV/N-44-XI; Ob valley north of Novosibirsk, 82-83E 55d20m-56dN), Quaternary map; NO LEGEND IMAGE on geokniga (map only, no imprint): units identified by the indexes printed on the map face, legend text taken from the series legends of N-44-IV (saQIII, lhQIV, orQIV, d+hQIV) and N-44-XI (alQIV); RASTER = geokniga 2000x2390 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px); vertical lithology ruling removed (work/r200d/prep_vlines.py); tints sampled and calibrated on the map (preview_tint_calib.py); lhQIV carried by two tints (base and dense peat strokes), orQIV not separable from lhQIV; the Ob terrace tints carry several printed indexes each and are merged: green = alQIII1+alQII-III3 (F), orange dotted = alQIII2+eolQIII-IV (F, hclass2 E), both restricted to the Ob valley (SE corner); dQIV ravines and aQ (pre-Quaternary bank outcrops) too small to separate; saQIII (subaerial cover loams) coded E (PI decision 2026-10-04); publication year and edition unknown (no imprint image); frame = 4 corners (paper edge and ridge filter agree) + interior 15x10 min graticule crossings as ties where found ; text from the series legend of N-44-IV (N-44-V has no legend image); seed = map tint; subaerial COVER loams: E per PI decision 2026-10-04
